$comment: Off-domain backlink and citation backlog. Traq is cited ~6.5x more often via third parties than via its own domain, and the 2026-07-31 audit confirmed it directly: every engine that recommended competitors was reading listicles and directories, not provider websites. This file is the system of record for that work. Anything requiring an account, a payment, a public client name, or a human relationship is marked ownedBy 'nazir' and must not be automated.

tiers.1-directory: Profiles already live. Rank inside them is driven by reviews, not by copy. Fastest measurable movement.
tiers.2-listicle: Third-party 'best of' articles that AI engines demonstrably cite. Requires a pitch to a human editor.
tiers.3-community: Q&A and forum answers. Highest AI-citation value per unit effort, lowest durability.
tiers.4-owned-profile: Profiles Traq controls. Keep the entity description identical everywhere or the entity fragments.

targets.name: Clutch reviews
targets.action: Request 3 to 5 reviews from past clients. The request email is drafted in Off-Domain-Presence-Kit section 1.
targets.why: Traq is already on clutch.co/ae/consulting/ai/dubai but sits on page 2. That list itself ranks 4th for 'AI consultant Dubai small business', so page 1 of it is worth more than any single on-site change. Clutch rank is overwhelmingly review-driven and Traq currently has zero.
targets.blocker: Only Nazir can ask real clients for reviews.

targets.name: Bayut AI training / AI companies listicle
targets.action: Identify the specific Bayut article Perplexity cited, find the editor, pitch Traq for inclusion on the next update.
targets.why: Directly observed: several of Perplexity's citations for 'best AI training and enablement companies in Dubai' traced to a Bayut listicle. A property portal is outranking every specialist provider on an AI query. This is the single clearest demonstrated path into Perplexity answers.
targets.blocker: Pitch must come from a real person. Drafting and target discovery can be automated.

targets.name: Edstellar 'Best Corporate Training Companies in Dubai'
targets.action: Pitch for inclusion in the 2026 refresh.
targets.why: Surfaced on both the US and UAE runs for corporate-training queries. Already an established citation source.

targets.name: Acamind Dubai AI training roundups
targets.action: Pitch, but note Acamind is a direct competitor that also publishes roundups. Low probability, low cost to try.
targets.why: Ranks top 3 on the primary training query.

targets.name: LinkedIn Pulse 'best AI consulting companies Dubai' authors
targets.action: Approach the authors directly. These are individuals, not publications, so the ask is a normal LinkedIn conversation.
targets.why: Two separate LinkedIn Pulse roundups ranked in the UAE top 20 for consulting queries. Lowest-friction listicle path because it needs no editorial process.

targets.name: Google Business Profile verification
targets.action: Complete the 'Get verified' step, then add the missing categories, attributes, opening date and photos.
targets.why: Profile is about 85% built and claimed but unverified, so nothing appears in Places or the local AI pack. Unchanged blocker since June.
targets.blocker: Verification requires video or postcard and can only be done by the owner.

targets.name: Entity description consistency sweep
targets.action: Make the one-line description byte-identical across LinkedIn, Crunchbase, Clutch, GoodFirms, TechBehemoths and The Manifest, and confirm none still describe ERP, data warehouses, BI dashboards or website builds.
targets.why: Perplexity blended Traq with five unrelated TRAQ companies (two debt-collection vendors, a Queensland trail-running association, and Traqq the time-tracking app). Identical descriptions across profiles are the strongest available signal that these are one entity. Also a chance to purge any surviving pre-rebuild service copy.
targets.note: The stale traq-collective.netlify.app site was 301'd to traqcollective.com on 2026-07-31, which removed the largest single source of the obsolete ERP positioning.

targets.name: Quora answers on AI training and adoption
targets.action: One existing answer is live. Add two or three more on training and activation questions, each with the employment credential attached.
targets.why: The existing Quora thread now ranks 1st for an SME AI-consulting query. Proven surface. Caveat from the audit: the page got cited but Traq was not named in the generated answer, so the brand claim has to be a self-contained sentence rather than a soft mention at the end.
targets.blocker: Cloudflare human check, and promotional answers need Nazir's own aged account.

targets.name: traqcollective.net defensive registration
targets.action: Acquire if cheap. Currently a parked lander owned by someone else.
targets.why: Ranks 8th on the branded query, which is a slot that should belong to Traq.

targets.name: Force recrawl of traqcollective.com
targets.action: Submit the homepage, /about and /services for reindexing in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools now that the legacy site is redirected.
targets.why: Perplexity was serving pre-rebuild copy describing services Traq does not sell. The source has now been redirected, but engines need a reason to revisit. The dateModified added on 2026-07-31 helps; an explicit submission is faster.
